clips.title: The story
paras: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, Senator Mehr Stonehallow faces a trogg invasion that has halted mining in Dun Morogh. He calls for help against the Rockjaw Bonesnappers so miners can return to work.

Senator Mehr Stonehallow has come to Gol'Bolar Quarry to direct the response to its trogg infestation. He serves in Ironforge's Senate and belongs to the Explorers' League, yet he has taken charge in person rather than wait for the city's laws to move. He hires travelers and mercenaries to drive the invaders from the mine.

Deep digging at Gol'Bolar Quarry broke into sealed hollows below the ground. Rockjaw troggs poured into the pits, smashed mining equipment, and drove out the workers. Stonehallow seeks to clear out the Rockjaw Bonesnappers, so Mountaineers can secure the quarry and mining can resume.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a member of the Senate and the Explorers' League, I've taken it upon myself to take care of this part of the trogg infestation that has gripped our lands.

They've certainly made a mess of Gol'Bolar quarry, and for no reason. As we dug deep into the earth, they poured out, destroying our equipment and driving the miners out. There's not much for us to do but to exterminate the lot of them, rebuild, then get back to work.
If you help me with the troggs, I'll gladly recompense you for your time.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If we can remove the troggs from Gol'Bolar quarry, it will be the first step of many that we will have to undertake to rid ourselves of this menace.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is a start. Hopefully we can take advantage of it, and move some Mountaineers in to secure the area. Then we can begin to restore our infrastructure and get the miners back to work.
Thank you for your assistance, friend.
